nl: 资产盘点（Ant Design Vue）：查询有资产名称、所属分类（下拉数据来自 /api/asset-categories 接口）；表格展示资产名称、所属分类、数量、状态、盘点日期；表格上方左侧「新增盘点」、右侧「导出」；支持新增、删除；新增、删除按钮需要权限码 asset:add、asset:remove；界面要求国际化；查询表单标签宽度 100px。
nlEn: Asset inventory (Ant Design Vue): query by asset name and category (the category dropdown data comes from the /api/asset-categories endpoint); the table shows asset name, category, quantity, status, and check date; above the table "New Check" is on the left and "Export" on the right; supports add and delete; the add and delete buttons require permission codes asset:add, asset:remove; the UI requires i18n; the query form label width is 100px.
notes: antdv 目标 + 五维：i18n + apiParams(分类下拉) + formLayout(labelWidth) + tableBtns + permissions。导出 tableBtn 用 actionType:'export'（副作用按钮），非 dialogKey。
